test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

ROSE : IVQS :: SUIT : XLWT :: TIME : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is : Consecutive number series are added starting with (1) to the position value according to English alphabetic series and then reversed.

So,

 
• ROSE : IVQS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/936698765a0cf78a095673a119b862e0c6c4d71681e79218f78c74f362fda64f.png] ​

And,

 
• SUIT : XLWT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/003394539a6a665d930cd908296bf0501ef653874ea7314c95752afc03b7f4c6.png] ​

​Similarly,

 
• TIME : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd8e9cb19f9b6e02e935e20c958c63ef0cfc55e5c98edb444f28fce1e5c09cd2.png] ​

​Hence, **"IPKU"** is the correct answer.

39:T8ff,
